svg.title: AMAZON · PRIME VIDEO: 1,991 latency alarms audited across Prime Video's Apple fleet; 700+ alarms that could never fire; 74% false alarms of alerts that fired (approx.); Daily fleet-wide run feeding a live dashboard
svg.text: Built an end-to-end TypeScript tool that audits every latency alarm, recommends a threshold from each metric's own history and backtests
it over weeks of real data.
Shipped an on-call ticket bot: when a latency alarm pages, it re-audits the alarms that fired and comments the result and recommended
thresholds on the ticket before the on-call engineer opens it.
Kept the daily run inside AWS Lambda limits with a per-segment rolling metric cache in S3, refreshed incrementally and seeded by a
one-time sharded backfill as a Step Functions fan-out.
